paper_id: Chen et al. - 2020 - Lock-Free Collaboration Support for Cloud Storage Services with Operation Inference and Transformati
title: Lock-Free Collaboration Support for Cloud Storage Services with Operation Inference and Transformation
motivation: Cloud storage services' heuristic-based conflict handling causes unexpected experiences: losing updates, false conflicts despite coordination, and long sync durations.
problem_framing: How to provide transparent, lock-free collaboration by intelligently inferring editing operations and transforming/merging conflicting file versions.
key_insight: Most file-level conflicts are false positives—collaborators editing different parts can be auto-merged using operation-level inference and three-way merge.
method_signature: Edit-graph-based operation inference + conflict-graph-based transformation + hybrid CDC deduplication.
evaluation_criteria: Conflict reduction rate (98%), time overhead percentage (2%), CDC speedup (3x).
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: We feel it wiser to give up using locks. Cloud services cannot predict real-time editing behavior to determine when to request/release locks.
